Ellipsis only takes effect when a column can't wrap, so the `no_wrap=True` version in your second try is the documented route. The [tables docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) describe `no_wrap` as preventing a column from wrapping. The squashing of the other columns is a known behaviour discussed in #2890, so it is related to this report.
